methodology: No supabase_migrations.schema_migrations tracking table exists in this project (confirmed live, see applied-migrations.json / live-schema-snapshot.json). Applied status is therefore determined by live object existence: for every migration file across both known directories (src/supabase/migrations, supabase/migrations), every CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN / CREATE TYPE ... AS ENUM / ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE statement is extracted (including ones textually inside DO $$ ... $$ blocks) and each resulting table/column/enum-value is checked against the live production public schema. A file with zero such statements (RLS-only, data-backfill-only, comment-only) cannot be classified this way and is recorded separately as NO_DDL_UNVERIFIABLE rather than defaulted into either applied or unapplied.
